trap.label: if + passado
trap.wrong: If I would have time, I would study.
trap.right: If I had time, I would study.
trap.why: Em português “se eu tivesse tempo, estudaria” usa subjuntivo imperfeito; o brasileiro traduz a segunda parte como would nos dois lados. Em inglês, o if leva Past Simple e a principal leva would.

mcq.q: If I ___ time, I would study.
If I ___ the boss, I would listen.
I ___ travel if I had money.

fix.wrong: If I would be rich, I would help.
fix.right: If I were rich, I would help.

fix.wrong: If she has time, she would study.
fix.right: If she had time, she would study.

fix.wrong: If I was you, I will go.
fix.right: If I were you, I would go.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no 2º condicional: “If I have time, I will study.”
rewrite.answer: If I had time, I would study.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “If I am the boss, I will listen.” (irreal)
rewrite.answer: If I were the boss, I would listen.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no 2º condicional: “If we win, we will celebrate.”
rewrite.answer: If we won, we would celebrate.
